assertions.text: Validates headRefName at step 1, immediately after gh pr view resolves it, before any other step
Rejects a headRefName containing shell metacharacters (e.g. ;, &, |, backticks) against ^[A-Za-z0-9._/@+=-]+$
Stops immediately on a validation failure at step 1 -- never reaches step 7's git ls-remote or gh api -X DELETE with the unvalidated value
